sloka: तत् अपूर्वम् नर पतेर् द्Rष्ट्वा रूपम् भय आवहम् ।रामः अपि भयम् आपन्नः पदा स्प्Rष्ट्वा इव पन्नगम् ॥२-१८-४॥
transliteration: tat apūrvam nara pater dRṣṭvā rūpam bhaya āvaham ।rāmaḥ api bhayam āpannaḥ padā spRṣṭvā iva pannagam ॥2-18-4॥

translations.english: Never before did Rama see such frightful appearance of his father. He was seized with fear as if he trampled a serpent.
